refund-policy.article:
Maple Furnishers

Cancellation, Return
& Refund Policy

Made-to-order furniture, crafted with care. Please review our policy terms below.

✦
Custom Built
Every Maple piece is manufactured only after order confirmation.
◎
Inspection Led
Claims are reviewed and approved after assessment by Maple Furnishers.
◷
Report Quickly
Issues should be reported within 24–48 hours of delivery.
Section 1

Made-to-Order Policy

All Maple Furnishers products are custom-built on order.

Due to the personalised nature of our furniture, we follow a strict no-return and no-refund policy, except under specific conditions outlined below.

Section 2

Cancellation Policy

  • Orders can be cancelled only before production begins
  • Once production has started, cancellations are not permitted
  • Approved cancellations, if any, will be processed after deduction of applicable costs
Section 3

Eligible Cases for Return / Replacement

Returns or replacements are accepted only in the following cases:

  • Manufacturing defects
  • Damage during transit

No other reasons, including change of mind, aesthetic preference, or minor variation, will be accepted.

Section 4

Reporting an Issue

To raise a concern:

  • Notify us within 24–48 hours of delivery
  • Share clear photos/videos highlighting the issue
  • Include order details for reference

Delayed reporting may result in rejection of the claim.

Section 5

Assessment & Resolution

All claims are subject to inspection and approval by Maple Furnishers.

The company reserves the sole right to determine whether a product qualifies as defective.

Based on evaluation, we may offer:

Repair   |   Replacement   |   Partial correction

Refunds are not standard practice and are issued only in exceptional cases.

Section 6

Non-Eligible Conditions

The following are not considered defects and are not eligible for return or refund:

  • Natural wood grains, texture, or colour variations
  • Minor finish or polish differences
  • Fabric tone variations due to lighting or screen differences
  • Seasonal expansion or contraction of wood
  • Normal wear and tear
  • Damage due to misuse, improper handling, or environmental exposure

shipping-policy.article:
Maple Furnishers

Shipping & Delivery Policy

Made-to-order furniture, crafted with care. Please review our shipping processes and terms below.

Section 01

Made-to-Order Manufacturing

All Maple Furnishers products are crafted on order.

Each piece enters production only after order confirmation and payment. This allows us to maintain complete control over quality, materials, and finish.

Section 02

Delivery Timeline

As every product is made-to-order, delivery timelines vary based on: Product type and complexity, level of customisation, and production load.

Note: Timelines shared at the time of purchase are indicative, not guaranteed. We prioritise craftsmanship over speed and we keep you informed through the process.
Section 03

Shipping Charges

  • Shipping is chargeable and not included in product prices
  • Charges are calculated based on product size, weight, and delivery location
  • Final shipping cost will be communicated before order confirmation
Section 04

Delivery Process

Deliveries are handled through trusted logistics partners and in-house coordination where applicable.

The delivery team will contact you prior to dispatch or delivery. Customers must ensure availability to receive the product at the scheduled time.

Section 05

Site Readiness

Before delivery, please ensure: Clear access paths (doorways, lifts, staircases), adequate space for movement and placement, and necessary permissions for entry, if applicable.

Maple Furnishers is not responsible for delivery delays or additional costs arising due to site constraints.
Section 06

Installation Services

  • Installation is chargeable and may vary based on product and location
  • Availability of installation depends on service coverage
  • Installation, where applicable, is scheduled separately from delivery
Section 07

Delays & External Factors

While we aim to deliver within committed timelines, delays may occur due to: Logistics disruptions, weather conditions, regional restrictions, and supply chain dependencies.

Such delays do not qualify for cancellation or compensation.
Section 08

Delivery Acceptance

At the time of delivery, customers are required to: Inspect the product for visible damage or defects, and confirm receipt only after basic verification.

Once the product is accepted, responsibility transfers to the customer. Delayed reporting of issues may result in rejection of claims. Delay claims must be registered within 24-48 hours.
Section 09

Multiple Shipments

For orders with multiple products, items may be delivered separately, depending on production timelines.

No guarantee of a single consolidated delivery.

terms-of-service.article:
MAPLE FURNISHERS

Terms of Service

Please read these Terms & Conditions carefully before accessing, browsing, or placing an order with Maple Furnishers.

Section 01

Introduction

These Terms & Conditions govern your use of the Maple Furnishers website and services. By accessing, browsing, or placing an order, you agree to be bound by these terms.

“Company”, “we”, “us”, “our” refers to Maple Furnishers

“You”, “user”, “customer” refers to any individual accessing or purchasing from the website

Section 02

Nature of Products

All products offered by Maple Furnishers are made-to-order. Each piece is manufactured specifically after an order is confirmed.

  • No two products are identical
  • Natural materials such as wood and fabric will exhibit variations in grain, texture, tone, and finish
  • These variations are not defects, but a characteristic of handcrafted furniture
Section 03

Customisation Policy

We offer full customisation across dimensions, materials, finishes, and fabrics.

  • Final output may have minor variations from digital renders or reference images
  • All custom specifications are considered final once production begins
  • Custom orders cannot be altered after production has started
Section 04

Orders & Payments

  • All orders are confirmed only upon 100% advance payment
  • Cash on Delivery (COD) is not available
  • Maple Furnishers reserves the right to accept or reject any order at its discretion
Section 05

Cancellation Policy

  • Orders can be cancelled only before production begins
  • Once production has started, no cancellations will be accepted
  • Refunds for eligible cancellations will be processed after deduction of applicable charges (if any)
Section 06

Manufacturing & Delivery

All products are manufactured after order confirmation. Delivery timelines vary based on product type, design complexity, and customisation requirements. Any timelines communicated are indicative and not guaranteed.

Shipping Terms
  • Shipping charges are additional and will be communicated at the time of order
  • Delivery delays may occur due to external factors such as logistics, weather, or operational constraints
Section 07

Installation

  • Installation services are chargeable, unless specified otherwise
  • Installation availability depends on location and product type
  • The customer is responsible for ensuring site readiness before installation
Section 08

Product Inspection & Acceptance

At the time of delivery, you are required to inspect the product for visible damage, structural defects, and finish inconsistencies beyond acceptable standards.

Once the product is delivered and accepted, any damage due to handling, usage, or environmental factors becomes the customer’s responsibility.
Section 09

Returns & Replacements

We follow a strict no-return policy, except in cases of manufacturing defects or transit damage.

Conditions
  • Issue must be reported within 24–48 hours of delivery
  • Clear photographic/video evidence must be provided
  • Maple Furnishers reserves the sole right to determine validity of the claim

Resolution may include: Repair, Replacement, or Partial correction.

Section 10

Warranty

We offer a 36-month warranty on our products.

This warranty covers

Manufacturing defects in structure or workmanship

This warranty does NOT cover
  • Natural wear and tear
  • Wood movement, grain variation, or seasonal expansion
  • Fabric fading, staining, or misuse
  • Damage due to improper handling, exposure to moisture, heat, or sunlight
Section 11

Material Disclaimer

Our products use natural and hand-finished materials.

  • Wood may expand or contract based on climate conditions
  • Fabric colours may appear different under varying lighting conditions
  • Minor polish or finish variation is part of handcrafted production
These are not considered defects.
Section 12

Use of Website

  • Misuse the website or attempt unauthorized access
  • Copy, reproduce, or distribute content without permission
  • Engage in any activity that disrupts the platform
Section 13

Intellectual Property

All content on this website — including designs, images, text, and branding — is the property of Maple Furnishers. No part may be used or reproduced without prior written consent.

Section 14

Limitation of Liability

  • Indirect or consequential damages
  • Delays caused by external factors
  • Variations inherent to natural materials

Your use of the website and purchase of products is at your own discretion.

Section 15

Third-Party Platforms

Maple Furnishers may offer products through third-party platforms (such as marketplaces).

  • Platform-specific policies may also apply
  • Maple’s manufacturing and product standards remain consistent
Section 16

Governing Law

These terms shall be governed by the laws of India. All disputes shall be subject to the jurisdiction of Delhi.

Section 17

Updates to Terms

We reserve the right to update or modify these Terms at any time. Users are encouraged to review this page periodically.
